issue: Password is not validated at sign-in; any password authenticates an existing account
actual: While logged out, submitted login.email='qa.alpha@example.com' with an incorrect password 'WrongPassword999' (registered password was 'Passw0rd123'). The app redirected to http://localhost:7019/ and the nav changed to the authenticated state (nav.profile='qa_tester_alpha', nav.logout and nav.new-thread present), i.e. a full logged-in session was created. No error was shown and the login was not rejected.
evidence: Post-submit nav snapshot: navigation=[nav.new-thread 'New Thread', nav.profile 'qa_tester_alpha'], action=[nav.logout]

Registered qa_tester_alpha / qa.alpha@example.com / 'Passw0rd123' -> redirected to home with authenticated nav (nav.profile='qa_tester_alpha', nav.logout). Logged out -> nav returned to Login/Register. Duplicate username 'qa_tester_alpha' (new email) and duplicate email 'qa.alpha@example.com' (new username) both stayed on /register with no account created and no sign-in. Signed back in with the same credentials -> authenticated nav restored. (Note: duplicate rejection is silent, no error text rendered.)

Edit Profile -> set profile.bio.input='QA engineer who loves testing forums.', profile.interests.input='Testing, Automation, Coffee' -> Save. Profile card now shows profile.bio='QA engineer who loves testing forums.' and profile.interests rendered as separate tags 'Testing','Automation','Coffee' (comma-separated parsing correct) on the user's own public profile.

issue: Invalid submissions are silently ignored; missing information is never identified to the user
actual: Submitting the completely empty New Thread form leaves the page unchanged with no error text anywhere in new-thread.form (innerText contains only the labels/counter/buttons). Submitting with category='Technology' but whitespace-only title ('   ') and whitespace-only content ('   ') is likewise silently ignored. No native constraint validation exists either: new-thread.title and new-thread.content have required=false and validity.valid=true, and new-thread.category is a BUTTON that does not participate in validation. Blocking works (no discussion is created), but the missing fields are never identified.
evidence: Empty submit -> still /new-thread, form innerText='Category...Title 0/200 Content Cancel Create Thread' (no error). Validity probe: title{required:false,valid:true}, content{required:false,valid:true}, category{tag:BUTTON,no-validate}.

Created thread with category=Technology, title='Zebra QA Automation Patterns', body='Sharing some Zebra-grade patterns...'. Redirected to /thread/thread-1787905712246 showing thread.title, thread.content and badge 'Technology • qa_tester_alpha • less than a minute ago'. The thread also appears in /category/tech threads.list alongside thread-7 and thread-1.

/category/tech listed exactly the 3 Technology threads (thread-7, thread-1, thread-1787905712246). Switching to /category/gaming changed the result set to exactly the 1 Gaming thread (thread-4 'Best indie games of 2023...'). No cross-category leakage in either direction.

issue: Category and community counts are hard-coded placeholder numbers that neither match actual records nor update when records are created
actual: Category sidebar claims Technology (243) but /category/tech lists only 3 threads; Gaming (312) but /category/gaming lists only 1 thread (thread-4). Community stats claim stats.threads=1,045, stats.replies=4,823, stats.members=892, while the forum actually contains 9 threads total (8 seeded + 1 created). The counts also never update: Technology stayed at (243) and stats.threads stayed at 1,045 both before and after publishing 'Zebra QA Automation Patterns', and stats.members stayed at 892 after registering the new account qa_tester_alpha.
evidence: Counts identical pre/post creation: {general 156, tech 243, creative 89, lifestyle 167, gaming 312, news 78}, stats {threads 1,045, replies 4,823, members 892, online 47} vs. actual 9 threads / 3 tech / 1 gaming.

Search 'zebra' (lowercase) matched title 'Zebra QA Automation Patterns' only -> case-insensitive title match. Search 'SUITES' (uppercase) matched the same thread via body text 'end-to-end test suites' only -> case-insensitive body match, 1 result. Search 'qqzzxxnomatch' -> 0 results with threads.empty='No threads found. Try adjusting your search terms.' and search.summary='Showing results for "qqzzxxnomatch"'.

On /thread/thread-1, typed a non-empty reply and clicked reply.submit (button is correctly disabled while reply.content is empty). Without any manual reload the new reply 'Great question - I would start with JavaScript for web work.' appeared as a third item in thread.replies, and thread.reply-count changed from '23 replies' to '24 replies' (+1).

issue: Displayed reply totals are inflated seed numbers that do not match the replies actually listed on the detail view
actual: /thread/thread-1 displays thread.reply-count='23 replies' but thread.replies lists only 2 actual replies (reply-1, reply-2). After posting one reply the label became '24 replies' while only 3 replies are listed. The +1 increment is internally consistent, but the absolute total never matches the listed count (24 vs 3). Same pattern on other seeded threads (e.g. thread-6 '89 replies', thread-4 '67 replies').
evidence: Post-reply DOM read: {replyCountLabel:'24 replies', listedReplies:3}. Only a newly created thread (0 replies / 0 listed) is consistent.

On thread-1 (authored by TechExplorer): thread.upvote 47->48 with button gaining selected styling 'bg-primary/10 text-primary'; clicking again removed the vote 48->47 with selected styling cleared. On reply-1 (by GameMaster42): upvote 15->16 selected=true, click again 16->15 selected=false. Counts and selected state updated immediately with no reload; repeat clicks toggle rather than stacking, enforcing a single vote per user.

From /thread/thread-1, clicking thread.author opened /profile/user-1 showing username 'TechExplorer', 'Joined about 3 years ago', '2,450 reputation', bio, interests tags (Programming/Open Source/AI-ML/DevOps) and authored discussions (thread-1, thread-7). Clicking a reply author (thread.replies.item.reply-1.author) opened /profile/user-3 'GameMaster42', 'Joined over 3 years ago', '3,156 reputation', bio, 4 interest tags, and 1 authored discussion. All six required fields render on both paths.

Most Active initial order strictly descending by reply count: 89,67,45,41,38,34(thread-5),31(thread-3),24,0. Posted 4 replies to thread-3 (31->35). Re-checked Most Active: order became 89,67,45,41,38,35(thread-3),34(thread-5),24,0 - thread-3 correctly overtook thread-5, so the ranking updates with reply activity.

issue: No recent time window is stated or applied; 'Trending' and 'Most Active' rank by all-time totals
actual: The Trending/Most Active views state no time window anywhere: filter labels are just 'Trending', 'Recent', 'Most Active', the heading is 'Trending Discussions'/'Most Active Discussions', and the subtitle is 'Join the conversation with our community' - no 'last 24 hours', 'this week' or equivalent. Ranking also ignores recency entirely: the top four Trending entries are all dated 'over 2 years ago' (thread-6 156 upvotes, thread-4 124, thread-7 92, thread-2 89), ordered purely by lifetime upvote totals. Most Active likewise sorts on cumulative lifetime reply counts.
evidence: Trending row 1: '156 | News & Current Events | NewsHound | over 2 years ago | Discussion: The future of remote work'. browse.filters innerText='Trending Recent Most Active'; no window descriptor in page text.

Trending initial order strictly descending by upvotes: 156,124,92(thread-7),89(thread-2),78,67,56,47,0. Added 4 upvotes to thread-2 from 4 distinct accounts (qa_tester_alpha 89->90, voter_two ->91, voter_three ->92, voter_four ->93). Trending re-ordered to 156,124,93(thread-2),92(thread-7),78,67,56,47,0 - thread-2 correctly overtook thread-7. Note: ranking is by all-time upvotes, not a recent window (recorded separately under CT-20).

issue: Discussion-creation route renders a completely blank page for unauthenticated users instead of a sign-in screen
actual: While logged out, opening the discussion-creation route http://localhost:7019/new-thread renders an empty page: semantic_snapshot returns no elements at all ({"screen":"new-thread"} with no groups), document.body.innerText is '' and body HTML is only 256 chars. There is no sign-in form, no redirect to /login, no prompt and no way to return to discussion creation. Additionally the logged-out UI exposes no discussion-creation entry point at all (nav shows only Login/Register; nav.new-thread is absent), so the user is left at a dead end.
evidence: Logged-out GET /new-thread -> body innerText='' , bodyLen=256, semantic_snapshot={"url":".../new-thread","screen":"new-thread"} (zero hinted elements).

issue: No persistence layer whatsoever; all accounts, content, and session state are lost on page reload
actual: After reloading http://localhost:7019/ every change made during the session was reverted: (1) signed-in status lost - nav returned to Login/Register; (2) the registered account is gone - signing in with the exact registered credentials qa.alpha@example.com / 'Passw0rd123' stayed on /login with no session created; (3) the authored discussion is gone - /thread/thread-1787905712246 renders 'Thread not found'; (4) profile changes (bio/interests) lost with the account; (5) replies reverted - thread-1 back to '23 replies' (was 24), thread-3 back to '31 replies' (was 35); (6) vote state reverted - thread-2 back to 89 upvotes (was 93). Storage probe shows localStorage=[], sessionStorage=[], cookies='' - state is in-memory only.
evidence: Post-reload home threads.list shows only the 8 seed threads with original counts; login with valid credentials rejected; created thread 404s; no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie entries.

Within one loaded session (no reload): registered qa_beta, saved bio 'Beta session persistence tester.' + interests 'Persistence, Sessions', authored 'Beta Session Persistence Thread' (Creative Corner), replied on thread-1 (23->24 replies) and upvoted thread-1 (47->48, selected). Logged out via nav.logout, logged back in via the login form, then re-checked: profile.card still shows bio and both interest tags with authored thread 'Beta Session Persistence Thread'; thread-1 still shows 24 replies including 'Beta session reply for persistence check.'; upvotes still 48 with the user's own vote still rendered as selected (voted=true). Baseline and post-relogin reads are identical.
